pages.text: This series can be optionally equipped with an Intelligent Production Operation System (IPROS MX) alongside the existing controller. This intelligent platform provides 19 smart functions for machine users, aiming to improve operational workflow efficiency and enhance interaction between operators and the machine. This series can also be optionally equipped with an Intelligent Temperature Control System (Spindle Temperature Assistance System), installed externally next to the machine. The system quickly brings the machine to thermal stability, effectively controls the cooling rate, minimizes spindle accuracy variation, and provides faster, more effective management of temperature, precision, and thermal deformation. The main castings are made of high-grade Meehanite cast iron, with rib-reinforced design to enhance rigidity characteristics, ensuring exceptional stability during high-speed machining. The exterior sheet-metal design features fully enclosed panels with no exposed reinforcing ribs or cables. Visual surround-type light strip. Lightweight CRT swing arm. In-house made rate of parts reaches 74.5%. Optional Intelligent operation platform (IPROS MX) and intelligent temperature control system( spindle tempera- ture auxiliary system) can be set to improve operation efficiency. This is a highly cost-effective and innovative vertical machining center.

Features a unique machine structure, delivering superior rigidity and stability compared to other machines in the same class. Unlike general hollow type rib designs, we adopt a unique keel-type structure with excellent resistance to bending and torsion. The column cross-closed structure combined with the keel design improves bending rigidity by 42% and torsional rigidity by 17%. This robust structure provides a solid foundation for overall machine performance. A wide 1,900 mm (74.8”) four-guideway base, together with full-stroke Y-axis saddle support, prevents X-axis table overhang and delivers outstanding rigidity and dynamic machining accuracy. Six telescoping cover (front three and back three) are used for Y axis to prevent the accumulation of chips and accelerate the removal of chips. Featuring a dual-guideway base with full three-axis support, the design minimizes overhang and ensures exceptional rigidity by eliminating sagging. MOTOR: αiI 12, αiI15 MOTOR: αiI 12, αiI15

The CE series direct drive spindle is equipped with high-precision angular contact ball bearings and lubricated with high-performance grease to effectively control heat generation. Its high-rigidity spindle head structure ensures maximum stability during high-speed cutting, delivering exceptional- ly fine surface finishes. The direct drive spindle design eliminates mechanical noise, backlash, and vibration, enhancing both machining efficiency and quality. For energy saving and environmental protection, the KMC-168CE uses a nitrogen-hydraulic counterbalance and air-to-oil tool release system, cutting energy use and environmental impact.
